messages:
sam: NimbusEdge reports 3 POs rejected. ERP renamed SKUs (GR-42-pro -> GR42-PRO) and their invoices list NimbusEdge GmbH while contract shows NimbusEdge Inc. Need payment to meet shipping window next week.
marketplace-bot: PO 99111 rejected reason: SKU_NOT_FOUND (GR42-PRO)
maria: Which POs? I can check ingest logs and finance routing.
sam: 99111, 99112, 99113. 99112 flagged for billingEntity mismatch. Partner asks to keep Wed launch.
zoe: Fastest fix: add alias mapping in ingest for affected SKUs.
cal: Billing entity mismatch requires finance/legal signoff to route invoices to GmbH. We can accept if partner signs short consent and TAX ID verifies.
eli: I'll draft consent: two lines authorizing temp alias and invoice routing for listed POs, no SOW changes.
marketplace-bot: Task task-7019 created: marketplace-ingest-alias assigned to zoe due 2025-01-22
zoe: Adding alias now. Command: curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/ingest/aliases -d '{"from":"GR42-PRO","to":"GR-42-pro","partner":"NimbusEdge GmbH"}'
marketplace-bot: Deploy OK, feature flag marketplace.aliasing=true
maria: Reprocess started rq-20250121-09
marketplace-bot: Reprocess: 99111 Accepted, 99112 Pending (billing_entity_mismatch), 99113 Accepted
eli: Consent sent to legal@nimbusedge.de. Subject: Temporary SKU alias + invoice routing consent.
marketplace-bot: Partner signed consent uploaded doc-4432
maria: Finance verified TAX ID DE987654321, reprocessing 99112 now.
marketplace-bot: Reprocess complete: 99112 Accepted. All three accepted.
sam: Told partner they can ship. They want launch unchanged.
zoe: Will add onboarding fields: 'operational invoice entity' + 'sku_stable_id flag' and open infra PR.
cal: Updating finance playbook for emergency alias routing.
eli: Legal will add consent template to playbook for partnerships.
sam: Closing thread, linking playbook entries to task.
